_comment: Copy beside a plugin as <name>.json (or <name>.plugin.json) and fill in. `sha256` is of the .py file: python -c "import hashlib,pathlib;print(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('plugins/my_plugin.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest())". The permission list is what the user is asked to consent to, and core/plugin_manifest.py refuses the plugin if the source uses something it did not declare.
name: my_plugin
author: your name
description: One sentence a person reads before installing.
